conversions: Earth/Moon medium packs: 1024x512 orbital and 2048x1024 detail materials; gas albedo from low packs
Earth/Moon high packs: optional 4096x2048 close materials; height and buildability stay independent of visual LOD
RG tangent slopes decoded to RGB tangent normals
material R extracted as roughness; cloud R extracted as alpha
RG16 height decoded before nearest sampling to 128x64 orbital and 1024x512 detail uint16 LE fields
surfaceClass 1 -> land 255; 0 and 2-6 -> unavailable 0; nearest categorical sampling
512x256 buildability: maximum eight-neighbour detail slope over 2x2 footprint, ceil degrees 0-254; 255 water/no-data

Mars/Mercury: albedo from Perilune medium/high packs; relief from MOLA MEGDR 16 ppd and the USGS MESSENGER 665 m DEM, area-averaged to 128x64, 1024x512 and 4096x2048 over one min-max datum per body; normals from that relief (slope factor fitted to the Moon); roughness from albedo
